title: Guanidine and PBS Transfer with CSV
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your CSV and input your protocol parameters.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Attach pipettes and load tipracks
steps.instruction: Mount the P10 Single Pipette and the P50 Single Pipette on the OT‑2 robot and place the required tipracks and labware on the deck.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the P10 Single Pipette and P50 Single Pipette are attached (left or right mount as you prefer).
Load an Opentrons 10 µL Tiprack (slot 1) and an Opentrons 50/300 µL Tiprack onto the deck.
Place a USA Scientific 12‑Well Reservoir (22 mL) and a Corning 384‑Well Plate (112 µL capacity) on the deck as indicated in the deck map.

steps.title: Create CSV transfer file
steps.instruction: Prepare a .csv file that defines the Guanidine and PBS transfers for each well.

substeps.instruction: Create a CSV file with three columns: “Well”, “Guanidine Amount (µL)”, “PBS Amount (µL)”.
The first row may contain these headers (or can be data).
Each subsequent row lists a well identifier (e.g., A1) and the exact µL volumes of Guanidine and PBS to be transferred to that well.

steps.title: Configure OT‑2 protocol builder
steps.instruction: Upload the CSV and set pipette mount parameters in the OT‑2 protocol configurator.

substeps.instruction: Upload your properly formatted CSV file.
Specify which mount (left or right) holds the P10 Single Pipette.
Specify which mount (left or right) holds the P50 Single Pipette.
Confirm that you are using the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App version 3.15.0 or later.

steps.title: Generate and download protocol
steps.instruction: Create the robot protocol file and save it to your computer.

substeps.instruction: Click the “Download your protocol” button to obtain the JSON protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: Load the generated protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App.

substeps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, select “Upload protocol” and choose the downloaded file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange all labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

substeps.instruction: Place the 10 µL tiprack, 50/300 µL tiprack, 12‑well reservoir, and 384‑well plate in the slots indicated by the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration procedures for tipracks, reservoir, plate, and both pipettes using the OT‑2 App.

substeps.instruction: Follow the on‑screen prompts to calibrate each piece of labware.
Refer to Opentrons support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the transfer protocol
steps.instruction: Start the robot run to transfer Guanidine and PBS as defined in the CSV.

substeps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT‑2 App.
